title: Parse Ids
statement: Implement `solve(lines)`. Skip lines that are blank after stripping and lines whose stripped text starts with `#`. Return the remaining lines stripped, in order.
constraints: A comment may have leading spaces
Do not parse the ids further
hints: Strip once and reuse that string.
Continue on empty or hash-leading lines.

approaches.name: Direct
approaches.explanation: An id file is a line protocol with comments.

editorial: An id file is a line protocol with comments. The strip has to happen before the comment test, or a space before the hash becomes an id. The result is the ids, not the raw lines.
